claims.statement: The root npm test script is a single && chain that runs shell and Node selftests (deploy-vps, wiki-delta-emitter, live-identity-evidence, integration-probes) before building the shared and agent-catalog workspaces and running workspace vitest suites, so harness breakage fails the gate before any vitest assertion executes; the earlier paperclip-archive-export/paperclip-readonly-monitor Python selftest steps have been removed along with their scripts.

The server workspace vitest config (packages/server/vitest.config.mts) enables globals, uses the node environment, includes src/**/*.test.ts, sets NODE_ENV=test, and raises testTimeout and hookTimeout to 30 s because integration tests exercising the loop (git worktree add, working-tree diff application, multiple runtime spawns) legitimately exceed the 5 s default.

HTTP contract test suites stand up real Express apps and assert status codes, error codes, and response shapes over HTTP; most use supertest against in-process apps while critical-http-contracts.test.ts binds an ephemeral listening server (app.listen(0)) and drives it with fetch, covering auth, approvals (404 for unknown ids, 410/APPROVAL_EXPIRED for expired records, 400 for coerced decisions, 409 against cancelling terminal approvals), backups, runtime governance, MCP, spawns, swarms, SBOM, and repository-index surfaces.

The production mount table in routes/index.ts is registered exclusively through mountRoutes, and collectRoutes throws on any unrecorded nested router, so a manually re-mounted router cannot silently vanish from the inventory; the full-aggregator test compares the instantiated router against a static TypeScript-AST inventory (requiring declared_not_registered and registered_not_declared to be empty) and probes every auth-marked route over HTTP expecting anonymous 401s.

route-permission-contract.test.ts scans route sources for literal requirePermission('…') calls and rejects any permission name absent from ROLE_PERMISSIONS in @djimitflo/shared, requiring more than 100 guarded calls so the check cannot pass on an empty scan.

The integration-spine suites tie the operational loop together over real HTTP and a temporary git repository: they mount createWorkItemRoutes and createSwarmRoutes on in-memory SQLite with schema and migrations, point LOOP_WORKTREE_ROOT at a temp directory, and push one imported integration event through worker dispatch, checker, and learning closure; integration-spine-real-runtime-smoke is gated behind RUN_REAL_RUNTIME_SMOKE=1 with a default-only variant otherwise so certification is never silently substituted.

The Stryker mutation gate (npm run test:mutation) deliberately mutates only narrow line ranges in approval-service.ts (122:4–145:7: decision input validation, status/expiry checks, self-approval guard), tool-broker.ts (243:4–269:43: capability-token validation/re-evaluation), docker-sandbox-executor.ts (108:2–113:3: inner-command guard and /workspace working-directory enforcement), and runtime-governance.ts (20:0–22:1, 53:4–63:5: baseline score bounds and no-write validation boundary), with thresholds high 85 / low 75 / break 70; the CI mutation-test job builds @djimitflo/shared and runs this gate on every push and PR.

The assurance:* scripts are CI-gated evidence producers distinct from npm test: ci-audit fails on high/critical production advisories outside a commented allowlist including transitive chains; contract-inventory requires critical route modules to be source_referenced or carry written exemptions with a non-zero exit otherwise; integration-probes performs read-only checks of the live dependency graph (djimitflo /health, event bus, Paperclip, UAMS, Ollama, Qdrant, LiteLLM, Context7 MCP discovery, codex/opencode binaries); live-identity-evidence proves deployment identity via clean git state, health-commit match to git rev-parse HEAD, and authenticated deep-health provenance reporting mode live with matching commit_sha and database.instance_id.

assurance-truth.mjs composes the other assurance gates into a single evidence.json: it asserts a supported Node version (>=22 <25), runs audit, contract inventory, OpenMythos evidence, integration probes, live identity, and git diff --check (plus npm test/type-check/lint/build under --full), redacts credentials from captured output, hashes the dirty source state, and exits non-zero unless the aggregate status is pass.

The assurance scripts themselves are tested: assurance-truth.test.mjs proves redact() strips bearer tokens and passwords and that sourceState fails closed on a missing repository rather than substituting a clean identity, while live-identity-evidence.test.mjs proves verifyIdentity rejects dirty trees, commit mismatches, unconfigured remote identity, and non-live database mode.

The README states the governing discipline that claims are falsifiable via the test suite and green tests are necessary but not sufficient for production assurance; each assurance script declares its limits inline (contract-inventory's 'source_referenced means a static source-code match only; it is not proof a test ran', table-reachability's 'Static SQL regex references, not runtime execution proof.').

The M2 mutation-gain lane is wired from three pieces: vitest.service-mutation.config.ts (include = process.env.MUTATE_TEST ?? 'none'), stryker.service.config.mjs (mutates exactly process.env.MUTATE_FILE, vitest runner at that config, perTest coverage, concurrency 2, excludes StringLiteral/ObjectLiteral, JSON report to MUTATE_REPORT), and scripts/mutation-gain.mjs which orchestrates both. Without MUTATE_FILE/MUTATE_TEST the script is a no-op exit 0 so hosts can list it unconditionally in LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_SCRIPTS.

scripts/mutation-gain.mjs (npm run test:mutation:grounded) runs Stryker twice — once on the committed HEAD version of the test written to a temporary .mutation-baseline.test.ts and once on the working-tree test — and passes when the after score >= before + MUTATE_MIN_GAIN (default 10 points) or after >= 90, printing a single mutation_gain JSON line and exiting non-zero on a failed working-tree run; the score counts Killed+Timeout mutants over valid (detected+Survived+NoCoverage).

The loop daemon reaches the mutation lane via test-gap-source-service: runMutationGaps (behind MUTATION_GAP_ENABLED, default off, MUTATION_GAP_MAX_PER_DAY default 2, one in flight) creates a grounded proposal whose runtime command is 'MUTATE_FILE=<service> MUTATE_TEST=<test> npm run test:mutation:grounded'; mutationCheckEnv returns MUTATE_FILE/MUTATE_TEST for a mutation-gap goal, and the daemon treats a goal with a non-empty mutationCheckEnv as the mutation lane, giving its maker 600 s and a 400-line diff budget (vs. 300 s / 200 lines elsewhere), dispatched through the normal daemonCheckOptions mechanism so a host opts in by adding test:mutation:grounded to LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_SCRIPTS.

evolve-selection.ts:mutationScoreOf reads the 'after' value back out of the mutation_gain JSON line from the test:mutation:grounded check's captured stdout, giving the mutation lane a continuous fitness signal for the E13 evolve loop; evolveSpecies returns extra makers only when LOOP_EVOLVE_ENABLED=true (at most two), evolveEligible limits the pilot to test-gap/mutation-gap goals (or metadata.evolve), and selectEvolveWinner keeps the fittest maker as the only non-superseded one while cancelling the losers' reviewer leases.

The agent-social-poller selftest (scripts/test_agent_social_poller.py, run via python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_agent_social_poller.py') is containment-focused: provider errors expose only the numeric HTTP status; runtime_env never leaks DJIMITFLO_SOCIAL_TOKEN/NODE_OPTIONS/OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT to a child and a provider credential reaches only its own runtime; each CLI runs in a fresh temp dir with tools disabled; an OpenCode custom provider config is written mode-600 scoped to a dedicated key and deleted after, with unsafe provider URLs rejected; untrusted reply fields cannot spoof runtime/model/lease/usage; and bounded_process SIGTERM-stops the detached runtime and its worker and a timeout kills the process group.

j5-test-gap-auto-approve.test.ts pins the J5 auto-approve lane: testGapAutoApproveScope returns the single artifact path only when LOOP_AUTO_APPROVE_TEST_GAP=true, the goal comes from the test-gap source, and its grounding artifact is one new file under packages/server/src/__tests__/; the M2 mutation-gap variant additionally requires LOOP_AUTO_APPROVE_MUTATION_GAP=true and at least one already-verified mutation-gap run. Auto-approval is recorded with auto_approved_scope pinned on the lease and a goal_auto_approved loop event.

loop-daemon-check-options.test.ts pins the deterministic-check knobs: daemonCheckOptions defaults to 120 s, scopes scripts via LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_SCRIPTS, and clamps LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS to 600 s; daemonReviewerTimeoutMs defaults to 300 s clamped to 900 s; daemonMakerTimeoutMs returns 600 s for the mutation lane and a clamped LOOP_MAKER_TIMEOUT_MS (default 300 s) otherwise; and runOutcomeOnFailure returns infra_failed (not regressed) for a maker that timed out or exited non-zero before its change was evaluated.

proof-run-service.test.ts drives the swarm proof-run endpoints against an ephemeral listening server with an in-memory schema-plus-migrations database, a throwaway git repository, and fake codex/opencode runtime binaries, self-skipping when not in a git repo or inside a Stryker worker (where process.chdir is unsupported); the root proof:test alias runs exactly this suite.

wiki-delta-emitter.selftest.sh runs wiki-delta-emitter.sh against a throwaway git repo with a fake curl and proves the baseline run records state without posting, unchanged and non-markdown commits never post, a real change posts wiki.page.changed for exactly the changed markdown pages with a wiki: dedupe key, and the state advances after a successful post.
